title: Admin Token-Family Lifecycle — List, Revoke, and Retention Cleanup
problem: Cycles 24-26 added refresh-token rotation, SQLite persistence, and rate limiting, but operators had no admin surface to inspect active/rotated/revoked token families, revoke a specific family, or prune stale revoked families and audit/rate-limit rows. Old revoked families and audit data would accumulate indefinitely.
root_cause: TokenFamilyStore only supported create/read/update for individual families and audit records. LocalAuthService had no list/cleanup operations, and createLocalAuthRoutes exposed only /auth/local-token and /auth/refresh.
fix: Extended TokenFamilyStore with listFamilies() and cleanup() backed by SQLite pagination, status filtering, and a transactional retention delete. Added LocalAuthRetentionConfig and service helpers. Added GET /auth/admin/families, POST /auth/admin/families/:familyId/revoke, and POST /auth/admin/cleanup behind requireLocalAuth, with hash redaction for admin responses. Added 5 new tests covering list, revoke, 404, cleanup, and missing-header rejection; fixed the subtle test issue where revoking the admin token's own family invalidates that token for subsequent admin calls.

variants.name: A - in-memory admin view
variants.summary: Fast but lost on restart and inconsistent with the durable token store.

variants.name: B - SQLite-backed list/revoke/cleanup
variants.summary: Durable, consistent with existing TokenFamilyStore, no new dependencies, passes all gates.

variants.name: C - external admin dashboard + Postgres
variants.summary: Best for multi-node ops, but adds external dependency and ops burden; deferred.
